The question at the heart of the novel

From What If...? Food for Thought

What If...? Food for Thought

Some doors feed your body. This one could change your soul.

In this provocative political and speculative fiction novel, a frustrated God watches a nation consumed by division, hatred, hypocrisy, and extremism. Determined to expose the consequences of intolerance, He inspires a sweeping new law that forces citizens to live under the very policies they support. As mysterious Agents descend across America to enforce these choices, lives are transformed, families are tested, and long-held beliefs are pushed to their breaking point.

Five Lives. One Law.

Five interconnected stories. One question none of them can avoid.

As the new law reaches further into daily life, the Agents appear wherever belief is about to be tested: a pulpit, a porch, a roadside, a podium, a backyard full of family.

Faith

The sanctuary isn't exempt. When the Agents line the aisle, belief goes on trial.

Family

Safety has a price. Tonight, this family finds out who pays it first.

Justice

One driver. Eight officers. A law built for everyone, tested on one.

Power

She preached certainty from this podium. The Agents are here to collect on it.

Ordinary Life

Before the law reaches them, this family just wants one more summer like this.
